method: Read-only code audit; predicted refusals below are not PostgreSQL or HTTP observations.

bounded: GeoJSON retain accepts nonempty bytes <=16 MiB and a whole FeatureCollection of 1-2000 features.
inspectedProfile requires EPSG:4326, CRS evidence and Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry types.
Source profile geojson-manual-v1; source and inspection status needs_input; manualProfile and gis retained.
Registration itself accepts other retained profiles; vector/probed alone does not imply recipe eligibility.
For CA0, filter the exact manual profile, current source/operator pins, bounds and nonconflicting stated CRS.
larger: Manual retain refuses >16 MiB with 413 FILE_SIZE; it never silently selects the large-original route.
LargeOriginalService publishes large-original-v1, needs_input, inspection.largeOriginal, no manualProfile.
Both large-original/1 and /2 transports publish that source profile; neither is accepted by manual recipes.

model: Tick reads queued/running jobs due by next_attempt_at, ordered by created_at, LIMIT 12.
streaming-vector and streamed-profile each use one process-local worker Promise; no named lane setting.
Each branch returns before generic geo dispatch; its fenced worker owns durable recovery.
streaming-vector enqueue inserts jobs then calls registerUspJobInputTx in the same transaction.
Shared attempts use a 180-second lease, reject a live owner and allow at most three claims.
After the attempt limit, USP_JOB_ATTEMPTS requires explicit retry; no new timer or queue is necessary.
answers.oneActiveChoice: A per-item pg_advisory_xact_lock and locked active-job lookup; jobs_pending is not unique.
ownershipBlocker: registerUspJobInputTx explicitly allowlists operations and rejects intake-draft with 422 USP_JOB_OPERATION.
Its intake-draft input/scope validation needs an edit in usp/jobs.ts, which is not an owned path.
The owned processing.ts entry alone cannot enroll this operation under the required shared authority.

autonomousGeojsonProposers.name: proposeAdaptiveMapping / AdaptiveMappingService.propose
autonomousGeojsonProposers.behavior: Existing bounded gateway proposal, returning a manual-geojson/1 MappingPlan or abstention.
autonomousGeojsonProposers.validation: validateAdaptiveMapping constructs pinned operations and invokes compileMapping.
autonomousGeojsonProposers.offline: No provider is permitted in this task; unavailable/disabled means no plan, not guessed fields.

notEquivalent: validateAdaptiveMapping validates supplied output; it is not an independent field-selection proposer.
proposeMapping/proposeMappingWithTeacher, lookupMappingMemory and chunk-mapping-agent produce MappingPlanV2.
StreamedMappingService authors person-supplied streamed recipes, not bounded GeoJSON MappingPlan proposals.
No other autonomous manual-geojson/1 producer found by searching server MappingPlan imports/construction.
catalogue: getSourceCatalogEntry(id) matches an explicit catalogue id exactly; there is no uploaded-file matcher.
Entries carry provider/dataset IDs/URLs, adapter fields and optional pinned snapshot hashes.
Acquisition callers supply catalogue sourceId; nycQuery explicitly selects nyc-building-footprints.
The NYC catalogue snapshot is a different Bronx hash; the NYC 10013 input does not match it.
Manual GeoJSON receipt has no catalogue id, issuer or dataset URL field establishing that selection.
Filename or schema resemblance is not publisher identity. A clean offline run has no catalogue plan.
With no approved memory and gateway off, the prescribed no-layout needs_answer outcome is expected.
answers.memory: Reuse approved/executed recipes by operator and exact schemaFingerprint; repin and validate.
answers.learnerSeam: A GeoJSON learner proposer remains absent; no new seam is built because Step 0 stops.

cases: createSourceCase inserts an UNASSIGNED frame and no site_id; its retained source remains in that case.
new_area execution creates a fresh registry_site and map_area with equal IDs and the normalized reference.
ingestArea creates a package case at area.site_id; retained packages archive that case.
retainedOriginal reuses source.id/object_key. It neither copies the source nor updates source.case_id.
No execute/ingest write attaches the original intake case to the new site; its site_id remains null.
existing_area can coincidentally share an already attached source case's site; that is not the new_area path.

readers.name: recordCommittedExteriorsTx (CA1)
readers.condition: Native observed exterior building, no spatialExtraction, nonempty source/feature evidence.
readers.site: Joins physical_features.record_id to registry_records and requires area.site_id=record.site_id.
readers.result: No source-case gate: an eligible committed reservation can store the citation at revision 1.
readers.limit: Storing a citation does not grant admission to that source at the site's downstream readers.

readers.name: targetRows / snapshotSourceRowsTx (CA2)
readers.condition: Collects cited source IDs, then sources JOIN cases WHERE c.site_id=selected site.
readers.result: An unassigned/different-site source is omitted, not captured or explicitly refused here.
readers.capture: snapshotSourceRowsTx visits only selected rows; it cannot recover the omitted source.
readers.exception: source-stated pins are only for sourceOnly spaces, not this exterior building target.

readers.name: assessPlanTx (CA4)
readers.condition: capturedTx requires the source body; declaration authority requires an active case at scopeId.
readers.result: Missing source member yields 409 STALE_REVISION before feature admission or extraction.
readers.control: A supplied captured body cannot bypass site equality: 403 DECLARATION_SOURCE_DENIED.
readers.profile: Even with site binding, the feature case requires geojson-area-v2, inspected/interpreted.

readers.name: permitsFeatureRecordSource / evidenceChecks (CA4 detailed review)
readers.condition: record only, inspected/interpreted native area profile; caller first filters by case site_id.
readers.result: manual profile policy is false; differing case site independently gives 422 EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE.
readers.limit: Changing the owned profile policy cannot make the site-filtered query find an unassigned source.

readers.name: evidenceChecks frame check
readers.condition: assertRegistrySourceFrame compares inspection.frame id/benchmark/units only if a frame exists.
readers.result: Runs only after evidence admission; differing case/site has already refused the source.
readers.manual: Manual CRS is in manualProfile/gis, not inspection.frame; no new frame inference is allowed.

earlierRefusal: For the NYC original, CAR reports one INVALID_GEOMETRY rejection, so native ingest produces quarantine.
Before inserting the package, ingestArea calls assertPackageDocumentAuthority.
Its quarantine gate joins the retained source case and area, demanding same site and active case.
For an unassigned source/new area, predicted result is 403 AREA_SOURCE_DENIED and execute rolls back.
This is an unowned areas/package-authority.ts repair, not permission to bypass quarantine or fabricate review.
answers.conclusion: Stop (b): the required front-door new_area chain has no site authority for its retained source.

answers.actualCapture: No retained source member is captured by this new_area target path because of answer 4.
projectionIfSiteAuthorized: captureDocumentSourceTx spreads the entire source row and inspection, appending referenceParts.
profile=geojson-manual-v1; source.status=needs_input; inspection.profile/status repeat those values.
manualProfile.crs has value EPSG:4326, nonempty evidence and degree unit; geometryTypes are polygons.
inspection.gis retains sourceSha256, bytes, featureCount, sourceCrs/crsEvidence and suggestedTitle/Namespace.
inspection.actor is the configured local operator. Source id/revision/sha256/bytes/object_key remain exact.
Neither approve nor execute changes that source status/profile/inspection into inspected/interpreted.
Decision-6 policy must identify these exact receipts, not all needs_input sources or large originals.
destination: Suggested destination values are retained in inspection.gis; no replacement naming authority is needed.
inspectGisBytes derives title from filename and namespace from SHA256 (and layer when present).
Studio AddFilesDialog sends those suggestions to direct import; bounded retain stores the same inspection.
answers.position: normalize_area enumerates the whole original, retaining indices after rejection; never split it.

ledger: SQL already permits required states, placement on_map/needs_answer, plan_ref JSON object and records_seen.
appendIntakeItemTx publishes those seven persisted event fields in the writing transaction.
Event means refresh; plan_ref/placement/count are not event payload fields.
IntakeItemSchema also omits plan_ref; writing internal plan_ref needs no schema change for decision 4.
Exposing plan_ref in the API later would require a separately owned contract/UI change.
answers.schemaDecision: No mandatory contract change found for internal jobs, recipes or ledger/event writes.
approvalCarry: A new source's repinned recipe is proposed. Today a person must approve it, then explicitly execute it.
CA0 would remove only the explicit execute request; it would still wait for that recipe's approval.
MappingReceiptSchema has per-recipe approval: planHash and server_configured_local_operator provenance.
planHash covers source/workspace/destination pins; decide execute demands that exact hash and approved state.
Cross-file approval needs a layout-scoped approval/lineage contract and a changed execute authority check.
Equal schemaFingerprint alone cannot copy an old approval; this task must report, not build that policy.

stop.decision: Commit Step 0 and stop without product changes or runtime execution.
needed: Decide explicit authority binding between an intake case/original and the destination site; never infer it.
Authorize the owning area/snapshot/review paths required by that decision, including quarantine admission.
Add usp/jobs.ts to ownership for intake-draft input/scope enrollment before implementing the dispatcher entry.

input.inventoryMethod: Listed the allowed files folder; no acquisition or external-data write.
